title: Great tour - lots to take in.
text: Great guide (Bernard) , very knowledgeable not just about the Sagrada Familia but the whole city of Barcelona. Took his time to explain everything in detail. We over ran time wise but was well worth the extra time.
author: TheMikeyR

title: Thanks to Paula!!
text: The tour was wonderful. Paula was very knowledgeable and really made it fun while giving us a lot of interesting information.  We overheard another tour guide from a different tour company and I was extremely grateful for Paula. Your guides will make or break your visit.
author: A5684ACjenniferd

title: Five stars, great experience!
text: We did the Chinese tour to Güell Park and our tour guide Kang was super nice and energetic! He seemed very knowledgeable about the park, and made it interesting. 10/10
author: GLee99

title: Excellent tours with Albert & Christina.
text:
We toured Park Guell with Christina (Sat 12/5/24 ) & also the on the same day  Sagrada Familia with Albert,& I could not praise both of them enough.
They were both very informative ,enthusiastic & knowledgeable.
 Christina & Albert clearly enjoy the history of both Park Guella & Sagrada Familia & have a passion for relaying this information on in a professional manner.
Highly recommend Christina & Albert.
author: L6086LHthomasf

title: An unforgettable colorful experience!
text: A very pleasant and very informative walk thanks to our guide Alberto who was able to transport us into a surreal world!
author: saumon59
